violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC observed at 43f and PIC mentioned it was having issues based off their data logger. Motor had been freezing over.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Temporary correction: Attached freezer door was opened to allow cold air to lower WIC temperature. PIC has work order in to have WIC fixed. Follow on or within 3 days for full correction.
